## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- France recorded 23,558K actual service units in 2025, +3.6% compared to 2024 (22,735K).

- Actual 2025 service units were +3.2% above the plan (22,827K).

- Actual 2025 service units are +8.2% above the actual 2019 level (21,782K).
